params.body:
The suite is 1800 tests and growing, and the CI ran them one after another: 3m45 of a job of
4m54 was the `Run tests` step alone. This makes `php artisan test --parallel` work here.

Two things stood in the way, and both are fixed rather than stepped around.

**A process gets its own database, which Laravel then migrates.** The older migrations cannot
reproduce this schema, which is exactly why the repository carries `database/schema/mysql-schema.sql`
and why the workflow loaded it by hand and wrote the pre-dump migrations into the ledger in shell.
`App\Support\ParallelTests` hooks into `setUpTestDatabaseBeforeMigrating` and does that on the
database Laravel just made, so `migrate` is left with what came after the dump. The two shell steps
leave the workflow, and the date boundary is a constant in code instead of a comment in YAML.

**A process does not get its own disk, and the disk is shared state.** `CompiledViewsTest` calls
`view:cache`, which empties `storage/framework/views` while five other processes are rendering
pages out of it; `Storage::fake` cleans one directory they all write to. The first parallel run
gave five failures that had nothing to do with the code under test. The whole storage path now
moves per process, not one directory, so the compiled views, the faked disks, the log and the
Passport keys move along with it.

**And it exposed a real leak.** The last test of `RemoveBackgroundTest` created
`background_image: weg.png` and never removed it. `settings` is MyISAM, so a transaction does not
roll it back, and every later test in that database then had a background configured that is not on
the disk: a second warning where one was expected, and no background where one was sent. Serially,
against a database made fresh for each run, it never showed. The class now cleans up after itself
like its siblings do.

**One more thing the CI said.** A test class without a database trait is never switched to a
process database: Laravel does that in `setUpTestCase` for the four database traits only. Such a
class reads the database from the configuration, and `MaintenanceModeTest` found it empty, because
the first version of this pull request had removed the step that filled it. The three shell steps
are therefore one command, `stocklist:test-database`, sharing its code with the parallel hook.

`ParallelTestsTest` pins the two mechanics, because neither of them is visible in a serial run and
nothing would otherwise say when they broke.

| | serial | parallel (6) |
|---|---|---|
| this Mac | 209s | 97s |

Twice in a row, same 1804 tests, same assertions. The CI runner has fewer cores, so expect less than
that factor there, but the same shape.

Replaces #664, which had that one red test.

params.title: Run the test suite in parallel (replaces #664)
